title: Steve Justice at To the Stars wanted to know how saucers flew

tellings.quote: Steve Justice, right? >> Yeah. >> And here was a guy who who would know where the bodies are buried, right? >> Yeah. >> And um he didn't know. He he really wanted to know how those saucers flew. >> Wow. >> That's what he told me. He says, "I want to know how they do it."

plain: Around 2017 to 2019, a man named Steve Justice, at To the Stars Academy, a private company set up to research UFOs, said he did not know how flying saucers flew and badly wanted to find out: "I want to know how they do it." The author Peter Levenda, who writes on the CIA and secret history, says Justice told him this himself. Levenda finds it striking because he saw Justice as someone who "would know where the bodies are buried", so his not knowing suggests even insiders lack the answer.
